checks_run: Inventoried and manually reviewed all 42 candidate files, including learner, sealed, provenance, license, and validation material
Parsed every shell file with GNU Bash 4.4.20 and independently checked strict manifest/provenance JSON and identifier consistency
Re-ran the public 8-check, sealed 9-check, adversarial 6-check, environment, real-runner, and starter-baseline checks under bounded timeouts, plus the structural pack check with configured Python
Ran an independently authored controller probe for argv preservation, lifecycle status, sorting, invalid-name rejection, and deletion scope
Built and ran an independently authored namespace probe with GCC 15.2.0 to check PID, UID mapping, hostname, cwd, proc visibility, and argv boundaries
Reviewed progressive-disclosure layout, license/provenance boundaries, learner guidance, and validation-label honesty
evidence: All candidate shell files passed bash -n; the public, sealed, and adversarial suites exited 0 with 8/8, 9/9, and 6/6 checks respectively
The real namespace integration exited 0, and the independent compiled probe observed PID=1, UID=0, HOSTNAME=reviewhost, CWD=/, readable /proc, and exact unusual argv elements

The independent controller probe observed exact argv boundaries, exit codes 0 and 1 persisted as EXITED, bytewise alpha/beta listing, status 3 for ../escape, and preservation of an out-of-container directory during deletion

MANIFEST.yaml and PROVENANCE.json are strict duplicate-free JSON; project, source, and commit identifiers agree, and the manifest claims only GENERATED and PARTIAL with productionized=false and independent_validation=REQUIRED
The candidate's recorded command outcomes, hashes, host-warning explanation, starter failures, and stated limitations reproduced materially exactly
Starter and public areas contain no sealed/reference directories; conceptual material, staged TODOs, public tests, sealed answers, and production caveats are clearly separated
limitations: Candidate-supplied suites and pack scripts are supporting observations only and do not by themselves establish any validation label
The immutable catalog baseline and linked upstream material were not available, so source snapshot, originality, and linked-resource license claims could not be independently re-derived
Only the full reviewer pack was supplied; downstream learner-view exclusion of sealed material was inspected structurally but not transfer-verified
No fuzzing, benchmark, cross-kernel matrix, crash-recovery campaign, hostile-containment review, or production qualification was performed
ShellCheck, rg, and git were unavailable; a first static GCC link also failed because static libc was unavailable, after which the independent probe succeeded with dynamic dependencies
Because CANDIDATE is intentionally read-only, runtime checks used the writable parent workspace as TMPDIR instead of the candidate-local paths in the builder record
